Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing compensation for school district boards of directors.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compensation for school district boards ofdirectors; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.320 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.320RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The school district board of directors may adopt a resolutionauthorizing each member of the school district board of directors toreceive compensation in an amount not to exceed one hundred dollars foreach day during which the member attends an official meeting of thegroup or performs statutorily prescribed duties approved by thechairperson of the board. (2) A person shall not receive compensation for a day of serviceunder this section if: (a) The person occupies a position normally regarded as full timein nature, in any agency of the federal government, Washington stategovernment, Washington state local government, or school district inWashington state; and p. 1 SB 5302 (b) Receives any compensation from such government for working thatday.
